title: Pendom
description: Mangala Sisa, a Bonda speaker, and Gobardhan Panda, an anthropologist and researcher, talk about making pendom, a drink like handia, and drink it together. They also talk about how it was drunk at Pus Porob, a festival that had just ended. They speak Bonda with some Desia, which is marked in 'single quotes' in the subtitles. Prateek Pattanaik recorded it in 2018 for Remosam, a 2019 documentary by Subhashish Panigrahi. A short part was used in the film, and the longer version was edited and published under the Munaremo project in 2024. Subtitles are by Gobardhan Panda and Subhashish Panigrahi, using Panda's 1998 book Remosam as a reference.
